task: Each source has two targets: finite2 with new response parameters, or recurrent with the original response parameters. Both targets share paid prefix controls. Private family labels and seeds appear only in the experiment protocol/results.
intervention: Both conditions have the identical complete procedure tool, editable shared program, common interface and atomic next_action recommendations. Only feedback_offer renders the optional procedure_action in research_advice or available_procedure_action in feedback. Interface-only suppresses this option through the rendering hook before it enters saved feedback or research state. Neither condition automatically executes a recommendation.
controller: After the common paid prefix, Luna chooses every action, including whether to invoke or edit the procedure and whether to authorize confirmation. Maximum 12 model calls; internal procedure steps consume the same observation, compute and execution budgets but are not model calls.
archive_publication: New predictors retain ordinary code, data and binary dependencies. Imported confirmed-model archives accompany them only when declared in the successful finish.reused_files. Runner logs and the undeclared candidate catalog are excluded. An unchanged directly submitted archive keeps its existing dependencies. Revisions to an inherited model publish a new candidate. A latest predictor explicitly depending on an older candidate retains that dependency, which is reported.
failure_policy: This development replay is conditional on the three existing published archives. The earlier failed source is disclosed, not replaced or retried. Keep every registered target failure and service interruption; unknown usage stays null.
accounting: No source is relearned. Preserve all four prior acquisition outcomes and their costs separately, including the failed source; report the three reused sources' costs as a subset. Actual new costs contain only this run's targets. Count actual operator executions, program steps and provider calls separately.
terminal_order: Finish all target learning before any terminal scoring. Existing source publication, not prior target or terminal correctness, determines archive admission.
scope: Six previously examined development targets, paired across feedback_offer and interface_only. Both use the same three actual source archives and paid prefixes. This tests presenting an available procedure as a current option, not new-task generalization or discovery of a learned research method.
model_identity: gpt-6-luna is requested through the existing subscription provider. Usage metadata repeating that name does not independently establish server routing.
adoption: Count actual outer procedure requests and executed method steps separately. Match each visible feedback option to the immediately following action using exact action and required-argument matching. A completed procedure must report completed plus passed fresh confirmation; target correctness still requires the common terminal evaluation. Interface-only may independently choose the tool.
